description: This file is a PHP script for managing test case editing operations within the TestLink open source test management tool. It handles various actions such as creating, editing, copying, deleting test cases and steps, managing versions, and rendering the GUI accordingly.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering HTML templates.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments from $_REQUEST and session data for test case operations.

methods.name: initializeOptionTransferCfg
methods.description: Creates configuration for transferring options like keywords between test projects.

methods.name: createWebEditors
methods.description: Sets up web editor configurations for different text fields, adjusting rows and columns based on layout.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Returns configuration settings for the test case management interface.

methods.name: getGrants
methods.description: Checks user rights for requirement management and other permissions.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI object with necessary data, URLs, permissions, and settings for rendering.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles rendering of the GUI using Smarty templates, based on the current operation and context.

methods.name: createNewVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a test case, updates status, and refreshes the GUI accordingly.
